get.description:
**Pre-computed regulatory wave state per crypto.** Answers questions like *'is asset X in an active SEC approval cycle right now?'* and *'how far through the wave is it?'* without making the consumer compute it from raw issuer data.

**Agent use cases:**
- **Trading agents**: regulatory-tailwind signal — issuers in an active wave have measurably higher near-term approval odds than those outside one.
- **Research agents**: temporal anchoring — when did the wave start, who led it, who's still pending.
- **Aggregator agents**: skip the cohort-graphing compute; ingest structured wave state directly.

**Returns:** ``{crypto: CohortStateOut}`` map. Each state includes ``in_wave`` (bool), ``first_anchor_date`` (when the wave started), ``first_anchor_ticker`` (which issuer led), and counts of approved vs pending cohort members.

**Methodology:** wave clock anchors on the earliest EFFECT or CERT filing per cohort (not 8-A12B, which can hang up to ~50 days before approval per the BAVA case). The wave window is fixed at 50 days from the anchor; subsequent approvals within that window are graduates of the same wave, not new anchors.

CohortStateOut.title: CohortStateOut
CohortStateOut.description:
Per-cohort wave state.

Cohorts (one per crypto category) sit in one of three states:

* ``holding_pool`` — no active wave. Cohort is waiting for an EFFECT
  or CERT to start the next wave. Issuers with a pending 8-A12B sit
  at the front of the queue (``latest_8a12b`` populated).
* ``in_wave`` — within 50 days of ``wave_anchor``. Pending issuers
  with stage ``under_review`` or ``launch_imminent`` are wave riders;
  approved-within-window issuers are graduates.
* ``cohort_cleared`` — every cohort member has been approved; no
  pending issuers remain. Hidden from the wave page (cleared funds
  live in ``/fund-monitor``).

The wave window is FIXED — once ``wave_anchor`` is set, ``wave_end``
is locked at ``wave_anchor + 50d``. Subsequent EFFECT/CERTs within
the window become graduates of THIS wave; they don't extend it. A
new wave starts only when an EFFECT/CERT lands more than 50 days
after the previous approval.

Attributes:
    state: Current cohort state.
    wave_anchor: ISO date the current wave started (the EFFECT/CERT
        that opened it). ``null`` when ``state == "holding_pool"``.
    wave_end: ISO date the current wave closes (``wave_anchor + 50d``).
        ``null`` when ``state == "holding_pool"``.
    latest_approval_date: ISO date of the latest EFFECT/CERT in the
        cohort, regardless of which wave it belongs to. Used by the
        frontend to determine whether a recently-registered issuer
        has "sat through" any cohort wave (which would clear their
        ``New`` badge).
    latest_8a12b: ISO date of the most recent 8-A12B from a CIK that
        has not yet been approved (no EFFECT/CERT). Indicates that
        the cohort has at least one issuer in launch-imminent state,
        sitting at the front of the pre-wave queue. ``null`` when no
        such pending 8-A12B exists.
    launch_imminent_ciks: CIKs of issuers in ``launch_imminent``
        stage (8-A12B filed, no CERT/EFFECT yet). These are the
        trigger-issuers that put the cohort in pre-wave urgency.
        Empty when no such pending issuer exists. Surfaced so the
        frontend wave-pin can render the actual triggering issuer
        alongside the ``latest_8a12b`` date.
    current_wave_graduate_ciks: CIKs whose first EFFECT/CERT date
        falls within the current wave window. Empty when no wave is
        active.

ConversionJourneyOut.title: ConversionJourneyOut
ConversionJourneyOut.description:
Trust-to-ETF conversion timeline.

Tracks the multi-stage conversion path for crypto trust entities:
Form D → 10-12G → S-1/S-3 → CERT → Trading.

Attributes:
    conversion_phase: Current phase — one of: ``pre_filing``,
        ``private_offering``, ``reporting_entity``, ``registration_filed``,
        ``under_review``, ``approved``, ``trading``.
    milestones: Ordered list of achieved milestones with dates and links.
    days_in_current_phase: Days since the most recent milestone.
    d_to_10_12g_days: Gap between Form D and 10-12G filing.
    d_to_registration_days: Gap between Form D and S-1/S-3 registration.
    ten_12g_to_registration_days: Gap between 10-12G and S-1/S-3 filing.
    registration_to_cert_days: Gap between registration and CERT/approval.
    total_journey_days: Total days from earliest to latest milestone.

EventOut.title: EventOut
EventOut.description:
A single activity feed event.

Merges notable filings and comment letters into a unified chronological
feed with human-readable descriptions.

Attributes:
    event_type: ``filing`` for SEC filings, ``comment_letter`` for
        UPLOAD/CORRESP comment letters.
    description: Plain-English sentence describing the event.
    timestamp: ISO date (``YYYY-MM-DD``) from ``published`` or ``filing_date``.
    company: Company name from the filing or comment letter.
    cik: Zero-padded 10-digit SEC CIK (for linking to issuer detail).
    crypto: Primary cryptocurrency (e.g. ``bitcoin``), or ``null``.
    filing_type: SEC form type (``S-1``, ``EFFECT``, ``UPLOAD``, etc.).
    link: EDGAR filing URL (for click-through).
    accession: Accession number (for comment letters).
    ticker: Primary exchange ticker (e.g. ``IBIT``), or ``null`` for
        issuers that haven't disclosed/registered one yet.
    exchange: Primary listing exchange (e.g. ``NASDAQ``, ``NYSEArca``,
        ``Cboe BZX``), or ``null``.
    symbol: Convenience composite of ``TICKER:EXCHANGE`` when both
        are known (e.g. ``IBIT:NASDAQ``). Useful for piping the feed
        into brokerage APIs that require full symbology.

GatedField.title: GatedField
GatedField.description:
Sentinel returned in place of a gated field.

Allows API consumers to distinguish three states:

* ``null`` — the issuer genuinely has no data for this field.
* ``GatedField`` — the field exists but requires a higher tier to access.
* actual data — the caller has sufficient access.

Example response for a free-tier caller::

    {"review_intensity": {"gated": true, "required_tier": "developer"}}

IssuerDetailOut.title: IssuerDetailOut
IssuerDetailOut.description:
Issuer detail view — includes review profile and filing count.

``review_profile`` has three distinct states:

* ``null`` — issuer has no review data (no comment letters or EFFECT filing).
* ``GatedField`` — field exists but caller needs a higher tier (free).
* ``ReviewProfileOut`` — full data for professional callers.

``conversion_journey`` is populated only for trust-path entities with
Form D or 10-12G evidence. ``null`` for all other issuers.

name) plus an upgrade signal so the caller knows the curation
metadata is gated, not absent.

ReviewProfileOut.title: ReviewProfileOut
ReviewProfileOut.description:
Multi-dimensional Regulatory Review Profile for an issuer.

Provides a richer view than the legacy intensity score:

* ``review_status``: ``"approved"`` (EFFECT filing found),
  ``"active"`` (recent correspondence), or ``"stalled"``
  (no activity for 180+ days and no approval).
* ``review_rounds``: UPLOAD count = SEC→issuer comment rounds.
* ``first_letter`` / ``last_letter``: Date range of review.
* ``approval_date``: Date of EFFECT filing, if any.

RiskScoreOut.title: RiskScoreOut
RiskScoreOut.description:
Risk assessment for an under-review issuer.

Risk levels based on percentile position vs historical approved
issuers' review durations:
- normal: <50th percentile
- moderate: 50th–70th percentile
- elevated: 70th–90th percentile
- high: >90th percentile
- unknown: insufficient data to compute

method.title: Method
method.description: Retrieval strategy used for this query. ``faiss`` = vector/semantic search against the FAISS index (typical case). ``keyword`` = text fallback when FAISS returned zero results above the similarity threshold. Exposed so clients can adjust trust/ranking accordingly.

VelocityOut.title: VelocityOut
VelocityOut.description:
Filing velocity alert for a pipeline issuer.

Tracks action filing counts over the current vs previous 30-day window
to surface issuers ramping up SEC activity.

Signal levels:
    - ramping_up: 3+ filings in current window AND more than previous.
    - new_activity: 1+ filings in current window, zero in previous.
    - active: 1+ filings in current window (baseline activity).

XBRLSnapshotOut.description:
Financial snapshot for an issuer — latest AUM, NAV, expense ratio, etc.

All metric fields are optional because not every issuer reports every
concept (e.g. newer ETFs may not yet have a full annual period).

Attributes:
    cik: Issuer CIK (zero-padded).
    company: Company name.
    period_end: Latest period end date across all concepts.
    aum: Assets under management (USD).
    nav_per_share: Net asset value per share (USD).
    shares_outstanding: Total shares outstanding.
    expense_ratio: Expense ratio (decimal, e.g. 0.0025).
    sponsor_fees: Sponsor fees earned (USD, period).
    total_return: Total return (decimal, period).
    fact_count: Total XBRL facts stored for this issuer.
